zh: 移除对话视图标签条、Windows 标题带、侧栏搜索与账号区域、会话统计、轮次导航与首页水波纹背景，标签、搜索、账号菜单和右侧面板改由宿主自己的控件承担。
en: Remove the conversation view-tab strip, the Windows title band, the sidebar search and account area, the session statistics, the turn navigator and the home ripple background; the host's own controls carry the tabs, search, account menu and right panel.
